title: galium boreale subsp. hyssopifolium
intro: Galium boreale subsp. hyssopifolium, commonly known as Northern bedstraw, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Northern bedstraw include wound healing, pain relief, and antiviral activity, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids. These constituents have been shown to possess antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, contributing to the plant's therapeutic effects.
